start.text: Yaaru? PG-ge bandidira? Come, come. Veg only, ah — no egg, no meat, not even in your tiffin box. Gate closes ten o'clock sharp. Ground floor ladies, first floor gents. One cot is free, under the window.

choices.text: Can I see the room first?

see.text: Good, you are sensible. Those token-wala people never show the room. … See: clean, fan works, hot water six to eight, window faces the lane. Now, money matters.

price.text: Ten thousand deposit, eight thousand rent, first month in advance. Food two times included, Sunday special. Everybody pays this, I'm not making it up.

done.text: Sari, done. Here — key. Lose it, duplicate is ₹200. Your cot is the one under the window. Go keep your bag, wash your face, rest.

walked.text: Hm. Go, see the other places. Shanthamma's price will be here only. Come before ten — after that, gate is locked.

later.text: Okay. But the cot won't wait long, ah. Engineering children come every day.

signed.text: Key is with you? Gate closes ten. And no egg puffs inside — I can smell from the kitchen.
